spots.name: spawn
spots.note: low ground in the valley; the range north, the hills west, the sea south

spots.name: hills
spots.note: rolling hills: walkable anywhere, no cliffs

spots.name: pass-foot
spots.note: where the climb to the pass starts (path ground)

spots.name: pass-mid
spots.note: halfway up: the too-steep band closes in on both sides

spots.name: pass-top
spots.note: the saddle, about level 6; shoulders too steep either side

spots.name: pass-north
spots.note: down the far side to the upland

spots.name: steep-band
spots.note: below the scree band on the range’s south side, looking north

spots.name: crags
spots.note: under the crags near the eastern peaks

spots.name: spire
spots.note: below the spire (level 15): its face, crags round its foot; no way up

spots.name: outcrop-slope
spots.note: the outcrop’s gentle side: walk south up onto it

spots.name: outcrop-top
spots.note: the outcrop’s edge, about 3 levels over the valley

spots.name: outcrop-cliff
spots.note: below the outcrop’s cliff, looking north at its face

spots.name: sea-cliff
spots.note: the sea cliff’s top, the sand flats below

spots.name: gully
spots.note: the one way down to the sea

spots.name: sea
spots.note: on the sand flats under the cliff

spots.name: plateau
spots.note: the plateau patch: whole levels, cliffs, ramps (like the generator)

spots.name: behind-plateau
spots.note: just north of the plateau patch: in the lift, hidden behind it (drawn as a silhouette)

spots.name: around-east
spots.note: round the range’s east end: the long way north

spots.name: knoll
spots.note: the knoll: a cone, 0.2 level a tile every way round (the uphill runs)

spots.name: rocky-path
spots.note: the rocky path beside the scree: walkable stone next to too-steep stone
